title: Cardinal Billing Account Rules Manual: Application Order, Accepted Payments, Posting and Overpayments
content:
## Section 6. Payments on the Cardinal Billing Account

6.1 **Application order.** A payment is applied in a fixed order:
1. returned-payment fees;
2. late fees;
3. reinstatement fees;
4. other fees;
5. the oldest past-due installment premium;
6. the current installment;
7. future installments, in due order.

6.2 **Accepted payments.** A payment of a method the plan does not accept is not taken, and while the account's certified-funds end date is on or after today only certified funds are taken.

6.3 **Posting.** A payment made after the pay plan's posting cutoff, Eastern time, posts the next calendar day.

6.4 **Representative payment fee (retired clause).** The clause stating that a one-time payment taken by a representative over the phone carries the plan's phone representative payment fee, charged once per payment and tied to it, is **no longer in force**. It is superseded by the current representative payment fee basis.

6.5 **Fee-free payments.** Payments made online, by the automated phone line, by mail or by autopay carry no fee, and no fee is charged when the payment cures a notice of cancellation or reinstates the account.

6.6 **Overpayment.** An overpayment stays on the account as a credit applied to the next installment where the pay plan holds overpayments for the next installment; otherwise it is refunded under the refund and write-off rules.

6.7 **Shortfall.** A shortfall up to the pay plan's underpayment tolerance does not make the installment late but stays on the balance.

## Application, illustrated (hypothetical)

An account owes a returned-payment fee of $25.00, a late fee of $15.00, a past-due installment of $100.00 and a current installment of $100.00. A payment of $150.00 goes first to the returned-payment fee ($25.00) and then to the late fee ($15.00); the remaining $110.00 pays the past-due installment premium ($100.00) and $10.00 of the current installment, leaving $90.00 of the current installment unpaid.

## Posting cutoff, both sides (hypothetical)

| Time the payment is made (Eastern) | Posting date |
|---|---|
| 7:59 p.m. on day P | Day P |
| 8:01 p.m. on day P | Day P plus 1 |
